website.label: Website
website.summary: The production website returned HTTP 200 during the 6 August check. The current release candidate expands national guidance, search coverage and municipality starting routes and passed the complete local pre-deploy gate before publication.

content.label: Published content
content.summary: The governed public catalogue contains 181 published local records and 23 national practical guides. The local dataset was generated from accepted releases, and sources for the expanded national guide pack were checked on 6 August 2026.

ios.label: iOS public distribution
ios.summary: Apple's public lookup service reports App Store version 1.3, released on 3 August 2026. The locally tested release evidence covers version 1.3 (build 8).

businessForm.label: Business and feedback forms
businessForm.summary: Secure Supabase endpoints and Admin review views are active. The latest read-only check confirmed expected server-side validation without creating a production record.

limitations: Endpoint reachability and invalid-input rejection were verified without creating a synthetic inquiry or feedback record.
